reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount (already handling missing/number/range) and the shared getApproxNumberThreshold, and routes every server, shared, API and client site through it.

duplication.why: Five copies of the missing/number/range ternary are removed in favour of the one helper; only a small redundant op check remains in schedule-template.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the API field is added in the API handler with a typed list entity, and client components just pass the operator.

scope.why: Every edit serves the four steps (rule, API field, approximate amounts, lowest value), plus tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: One function now owns expected amounts everywhere; the only wrinkle is schedule-template keeping its own `isbetween || isapprox` guard around the helper, which the helper already decides.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All amount sites call getScheduledAmount; schedule-template wraps it in a redundant operator check but still uses it for the decision.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; copies were removed rather than reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an op parameter and an isapprox branch, both the requested rule rather than caller-specific special cases; schedule-template keeps a redundant `isbetween || isapprox` dispatch around the call.
